name: Vegas Cubing Cup Summer 2024

venue.name: The Orleans Hotel & Casino
venue.address: 4500 W Tropicana Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89103

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VegasCubingCupSummer2024#37252-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com) and [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com): ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbnAvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--15a5362b7dafef77d8a7208815366d5958ab4162/scswcc.png)
